component.name: Justly
component.summary: Compose and play music in just intonation

description.p: You can use Justly to both compose and play music using any pitches you want. Using staff notation, you can only write the pitched notes of the 12-tone scale. Some intervals in any 12-tone scale are close to harmonic, but other intervals are not.
In Justly, you write pitches as rational intervals, so every interval can be exactly harmonic. You can also import MusicXML scores, play songs with a built-in synthesizer, and export them to WAV.

Song files from older versions of Justly won't open. To update one, rename each percussion_set_pointer element in it to percussion_set. Unsaved work from an older version that can't be restored is kept in unrestored.xml.

ul.li: Editing an interval out of range shows a warning instead of saving a song that won't reopen
Importing a score with a rhythm or tempo that doesn't fit shows a warning instead of saving a song that won't reopen
Importing a score with only percussion adds a pitched voice
Pasting malformed cells shows a warning instead of crashing
